name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 389 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 389 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces in Mendhar, Poonch, busted a hideout and recovered IEDs, while another unit recovered suspected explosives in Jammu and Kashmir, indicating ongoing counter-insurgency activity. In Manipur, a third accused was arrested in the Thoubal mob-violence case and gun and ammunition were seized, and a Kuki-Zo women’s forum called for President’s Rule, while COCOMI warned of intensified agitation from October 31. In the broader region, Pakistan refused to accept the bodies of its own soldiers killed in the Kargil war at the UN, and the International Crisis Group warned of a renewed Pakistan-India conflict over Kashmir. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Mendhar, Poonch, brøt opp et skjul og gjenvant IED-er, mens en annen enhet gjenvant mistenkte sprengstoff i Jammu og Kashmir, noe som indikerer pågående motinsurgasjonsaktivitet. I Manipur ble en tredje tiltalt arrestert i Thoubal-mob-voldssaken, og våpen og ammunisjon ble beslaglagt, og et Kuki-Zo-kvinnesforum krevde presidentstyre, mens COCOMI advarte om intensivering av agitasjon fra 31. oktober. I den bredere regionen nektet Pakistan å godta kroppene til sine egne soldater som ble drept i Kargil-krigen ved FN, og International Crisis Group advarte om en fornyet Pakistan-India-konflikt over Kashmir. 437 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
